payload.summary: Single-vendor plan review (claude_code; codex lane had no dispatch credentials) converged in 1 round with 10 non-blocking findings; accepted findings applied to spec.md, design.md and tasks.md. A first review round was superseded because its packet diff was empty (branch HEAD equals the base, the plan already landed on the base); it was rerun against a scoped base commit that excludes this change directory so the reviewer saw the full plan diff.
completed_work: Ran converge() inline (min_quorum=1, max_rounds=3); result converged, rounds=1, diff_kind=full

Spec: enumerated the three probed paths, added the no-change-dir case, required the text verdict to print the override detail, added scenario expedite.overrides-key-always-present, strengthened the drift scenario to both directions
Design: D4 drift test is set equality in both directions; D3 notes absent change dir means change_dir=None
Tasks: 1.1 updates TestCli ready/json tests to use a passing report; 2.1 adds the OVERRIDE_PREFIX constant and the overrides-key scenario
Superseded empty-packet round moved out of the change dir (kept in session scratch only)

decisions.title: Rerun plan review with a scoped two-dot base
decisions.rationale: The first packet was empty because the plan commit is already on the base branch; an empty-diff verdict is not a review of this plan, so it was discarded rather than adjudicated

decisions.title: Keep reason validation in main()
decisions.rationale: Finding that expedite() should raise on a blank reason was fyi; the CLI is the only entry that accepts the flag, so validation stays at the boundary
